remarks: Welcome to this move-in ready Colonial home located at 107 Leroy Avenue in the heart of Darien, CT. This warm and inviting residence offers the perfect blend of classic elegance and modern comfort, nestled on an expansive .71 acre lot.  Step inside to discover a spacious 2,166 square foot interior thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances and a seamless flow that makes cooking and gathering a delight. Just off the kitchen, the family room beckons with its cozy fireplace, creating a perfect backdrop for cherished moments with loved ones. The main level also features a spacious living room with built ins and a formal dining area.  The home boasts three generously-sized bedrooms and two and a half baths, ensuring ample space and privacy for everyone. Each space is thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and tranquility.   The house has a large unfinished walk out basement with plenty of space to use your imagination.  Outside, the private backyard and deck offer a serene escape, ideal for outdoor dining or simply unwinding in your own private oasis.  Situated in a desirable location, this home is just a short walk to the train and town, making it perfect for commuters and those who love to explore the local community. Embrace the warmth and character of this lovely home and make it yours today.
